key_insight: A PDE-consistent deep neural network closure, trained jointly with the LES solver, can improve turbulence modeling of premixed jet flames while remaining stable across changing Damköhler numbers.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more robust LES closure strategy for turbulent combustion, with better prediction of mean fields and resolved turbulence statistics than Smagorinsky-type baselines.
method: Augment eddy-viscosity LES closure with a deep neural network.
Train the closure jointly with the flow solver using adjoint-based optimization and differentiable programming.
Test multiple objective functions and training strategies across a wide Damköhler-number range.
evidence_signal: Compared with the Smagorinsky baseline, the best model reduces a posteriori errors in primitive variables by 25-50% and improves resolved Reynolds stress and scalar flux by more than 60%, including out-of-sample cases.
watch_item: Performance and stability still depend on training setup and objective choice, so deploying the model in new combustion regimes may require careful retraining and validation.
paper_title: Solver-in-the-loop training of deep learning closures for large-eddy simulation of turbulent premixed jet flames
